Title: This Japan-Only Face Wash Sold Enough to Stack 269 Tokyo Towers

Description:
Found at Don Quijote in Japan — the suisai Beauty Clear Paste Wash, a new enzyme cleanser from the 20-year-old suisai brand (Kanebo/Kao), the #1 seller in Japan's face-wash market for 11 straight years running. This paste wash only launched in September 2025, but within 6 months it picked up 11 Best Cosme awards and shipped over 539,000 units — enough to stack roughly 269 Tokyo Towers. Popular beauty YouTuber Hiro Odagiri's recommendation video sparked the buzz, and real reviews are split: some say it's not as instantly smooth as the original powder wash, but plenty say it leaves skin moisturized with zero tightness.
